_comment: Standard data of video_data_verify. Train: 10,000 frames sampled uniformly from the train splits of HF qicq1c/spatialencoder_full (100 windows of 100 consecutive frames; sequences drawn proportionally to their frame count; plan in data/standard_10k_plan.json): CA-1M 9,216 / ADT 500 / Hypersim 200 = 9,916 frames (one CA-1M capture holds fewer frames than its index entry, cutting its window to 16 frames), mixed by frame count. Test: 2 CA-1M val captures (data/ca1m_test.txt, 270 clips). Built by scripts/download_data.sh.
